dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Ethan is at risk due to behavioral reasons. Ethan arrived at MACC following a bite incident that resulted in broken skin. Ethan was fed next to another dog which resulted in the two dogs getting into an altercation. When someone attempted to separate the dogs, they got bitten on the left forearm. They are unsure which dog bit them on the arm. While in care, Ethan has been observed to fixate on other dogs with a forward body and high wagging tail. When greeting another dog through the gate Ethan is tense with a tight closed mouth. With handlers, Ethan will engage in a game of fetch and allows contact. Medically, Ethan has a bite wound, localized demodicosis, mild- moderate dental disease, unspecified dermatitis, lameness in the left front, and is underweight.

Ethan arrived at MACC following a bite incident. Ethan was fed next to another MMB which resulted in the two dogs beginning to fight. When someone attempted to separate the dogs, they got bitten on the left forearm. They are unsure which dog bit them on the arm. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only, single pet home that makes no trips to the dog park.
